title: RAW UNREVIEWED: an inner inscription continues an annular predicate instead of naming the adjacent figure
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. New official Cava199r pixels show COMMV continuing as red NICAT inside the annulus and a red inner IVNGITVR completing an annular clause. Consider an existing f57 inner inscription as a continuation of ring text, not automatically a figure name or quality. No target join or meaning is claimed.

changed_source.leaf: Cava Cod.3 official199r, image402.jpg; visible alternative handwritten203
changed_source.native_inspection: Whole official source image inspected in this producer pass; no target image opened. Lower-left annular COMMV continues with inner red NICAT, yielding COMMVNICAT. Upper-right red IVNGITVR supplies a predicate beside other inner labels. The corrected upper-left clause is SOCIATVR IGNI; the earlier SOLVITVR reading is not adopted.
changed_source.limits: This records selected source fragments and layout, not a complete accepted annular transcription or proof of direct Voynich ancestry. Source spelling V is retained; source space/colour changes need not be word boundaries.

design.production_mechanism: A diagram maker distributes a sentence across available ring and interior space. An apparent short label can be a predicate or even a continuation of a word begun on the ring. Different text colours and compartments can separate writing without separating the semantic unit. Other inner inscriptions can still name figures or elements: no all-label uniformity is assumed.

owned_target_construction.scope: Historically report-owned f57v.4/.5 R3/R4 and .6-.9 N1/.10-.13 D1 scaffold only. Current target admission is NOT established; root reports f57 absent from GDT791 image specifications and179-selector text allowlist. Historical exposure grants no present image or raw-text access.
owned_target_construction.known_layout: Four annular bands enclose four inward-oriented figures; four short inscriptions are near figures, four further inscriptions radiate through gaps. No leader, bracket or separate enclosure binds a short inscription to a figure.
owned_target_construction.important_mismatch: Cava source continuation remains close to annular writing; f57 radial inscriptions can have a different orientation. The existing layout description does not establish contact or baseline continuation for any nominated f57 pair. Proximity-only figure ownership does not imply ring continuation either.

finite_rivals: INDEPENDENT_LABEL: an inner inscription is a complete separate expression, potentially but not certainly describing a nearby figure.
CLAUSE_CONTINUATION: one specifically located inner inscription completes a clause from a physically adjacent segment of R3 or R4.

WORD_CONTINUATION: an even stronger one-pair hypothesis makes the inner inscription a remaining part of the same written word; source demonstrates this possibility but target has no such established seam.
design.new_consequence: Before any lexical fit, a chosen continuation must specify one ring exit, one inner entry and an orientation/contact path. It predicts a reading unit crossing that boundary rather than a self-contained short label. If the geometry instead supplies a closed ring sequence with no independently defensible exit, or the proposed inner text faces incompatibly without a written turn cue, that particular geometric account loses support. Geometry alone will not establish grammatical dependency, a word seam, or predicate meaning. Multiple equal paths remain unresolved; never choose the path whose words fit best.
design.smallest_next_step: First establish scope from the current admission documents without opening any target payload. The historical f57 scaffold can motivate this RAW mechanism but is not an eligible native followup. Only a separately authorized or documented admitted target could permit a bounded all-contact geometric review before words are scored. For such a review, fix ring exits, inner entries, baseline direction, separation and turn cues, retain no-join and clause-only alternatives, and do not choose a path for lexical fit. No decoder or pooled ring-label text now.
predecessors: GDT179 register/locus inventory is used only as layout; its eight quality readings are not lexical evidence.
GDT182 feature multiplicity and GDT184 one-bit R2 capacity remain unchanged. This proposal concerns R3/R4-to-inner text segmentation, not rescuing four elements or selecting a quality mask.
GDT185 failed f57R2/f67v1 reference alignment is not reopened.
GDT1152 local f81r.5 join does not establish a general word-boundary rule.
Existing f57 native visual pilot preserves PROXIMITY_ONLY and no direction/label translation. That ambiguity is motivation, not positive evidence for the proposed continuation.

Bounded reading-order/annulus/label duplicate searches and route-check found related alignment and cross-register work, not an established equivalent continuation. Lexical search is not exhaustive novelty proof.
design.structural_constraints: Raw seams and alternate-reader distinctions remain intact. No spaces erased, words fused, glyphs restored or source predicates translated onto target forms. Frequent forms and productive families must retain their profile obligations in any later lexical claim.
likely_failure: No target contact/orientation supports a continuation.
Several equally plausible paths remain, so no unique reading order emerges.
An apparent continuation is purely spatial and does not identify clause or word boundaries.
Even a supported reading path may leave all semantic roots unknown.
design.access: Existing reports and official Cava source image only; no Voynich image/payload, reserve, new admission, contacts or computation.
